name: Review questions (starter)
note: Things a machine can't decide, written as questions for whoever reviews: you, or an agent. Yours to edit: copy this file to your packs folder and change it.

rules.name: Money is handled as a floating point number
rules.question: Is money held as whole minor units (or a decimal type), never as a floating point number?

rules.name: A network call has no timeout
rules.question: Does every new network call have a timeout, and what happens when it fires?

rules.name: A loop or query has no bound
rules.question: What happens with no items, and with a hundred thousand? Is there a limit on every new loop, query and page size?

rules.name: A date is parsed or shown without a time zone
rules.question: Is every new date parsed and shown with an explicit time zone?

rules.name: A migration drops something the last release still reads
rules.question: Can the previous release still run against the new schema? Expand, migrate, then contract in a later release.

rules.name: Text won't survive translation or mirroring
rules.question: Is every new piece of text translatable, and does the layout hold with text twice as long and right to left?

rules.name: A failure halfway leaves something half done
rules.question: If this fails halfway, is anything left half done: a partial write, a held lock, a temporary file?

rules.name: An error says nothing useful, or too much
rules.question: Does an error tell the person what to do next, without leaking internals or secrets?

rules.name: A new setting defaults to the unsafe choice
rules.question: Is a new setting or flag documented, and is its default the safe one?
